description: Media Player is the best app to enjoy your favorite media content! If you are a lover of music and video, you can be sure that Media Player is the right choice for you. With Media Player you definitely will get only positive emotions from watching and listening to any multimedia! You get a lot of useful and exciting features like playing media files in different formats; the super search for the music on SoundCloud and videos on YouTube; adding files found to playlists; creating and editing new playlists; hotkeys when watching videos; Last.fm; Off timer and much more!
